Three men arrested in connection with Lawrence Bishnoi gang's alleged target killings

Lawrence Bishnoi, a notorious gangster, has been linked to several target killings in Delhi. Three of his associates have been arrested by the police, who claim they were involved in planning and executing these crimes. The arrests are seen as a significant blow to the gang's operations.
